question: The First Finance Commission was constituted vide Presidential Order dated 22.11.1951 under the chairmanship of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**KC Neogy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **KC Neogy** was the chairman of the First Finance Commission, which was constituted vide Presidential Order dated 22.11.1951.
 
• The Finance Commission is a constitutional body that is tasked with the distribution of financial resources between the central government and the states.
 
• The First Finance Commission played a crucial role in laying down the financial architecture of independent India.
 
• The Finance Commission is constituted every five years to recommend the distribution of taxes between the Union and the States and among the States themselves.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Finance Commission was established under **Article 280** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The recommendations made by the Finance Commission are advisory in nature and are implemented by the government as deemed appropriate.
 
• The Commission's role is vital in ensuring a balanced fiscal federalism in India.
 
• Over the years, the Finance Commission has evolved to address various financial challenges faced by the states and the central government.
 
• The current Finance Commission, as of 2023, is the Fifteenth Finance Commission, chaired by **N. K. Singh**.
